items.title: Is Micron (MU) Quietly Recasting Its AI Memory Strategy With New Leadership and 512GB DDR5?
items.summary: Earlier this month, Micron Technology appointed Deirdre Hanford as corporate vice president and president of Micron Research Labs and also unveiled the world’s first 512GB DDR5 server memory module, targeting AI, analytics and other data-intensive workloads with higher capacity and efficiency. By pairing a veteran ecosystem builder to lead long-horizon research with a record-capacity DDR5 module, Micron is tying its innovation agenda directly to future AI and data-center memory requirements...
